summary: The lecture covers the Aryan Invasion Theory by Max Mueller, detailing the migration of Central Asian tribes into India via the Khyber Pass and the subsequent division of Aryans and Dravidians. It explains the classification of Vedic literature into Shruti and Smriti, the four Vedas, and their structural divisions (Samhita, Brahmana, Aranyaka, Upanishad). Key details of each Veda are provided: Rig Veda's mandalas, deities, and Purusha Sukta; Sama Veda's musical aspects; Yajur Veda's sacrificial formulas and two recensions; and Atharva Veda's medicinal content and surgical references.
points: Aryan Invasion Theory by Max Mueller: Central Asian tribes entered via Khyber Pass with horses, chariots, iron weapons.
Aryans settled in Sapta Sindhu (Brahmavarta); Dravidians pushed south of Narmada to Dravida Nadu.
'Arya' appears 36 times in Rig Veda meaning noble origin; Das/Dasyu denoted dark-skinned natives.
Four Vedas: Rig, Sama, Yajur, Atharva; Shruti (heard) vs Smriti (memorized); Para (spiritual) vs Apara (material) Vidya.
Rig Veda: 1028 hymns, 10,552 mantras, 10 mandalas; Mandala 3 Gayatri Mantra (Vishwamitra); Mandala 10 Purusha Sukta (varna origin).
Major Rig Vedic deities: Indra (250 hymns, Purandara), Agni (200 hymns, intermediary), Soma (120 hymns).
Sama Veda: origin of Indian music; Veena mentioned; Stobha (repetition) and Sthobha (recitation process).
Yajur Veda: two recensions - Krishna (Black) and Shukla (White); Yajnavalkya vomited Krishna, learned Shukla from Sun.
Atharva Veda (Atharvangiras): 20 books; covers diseases (Krimi, Dosha, witchcraft, heredity) and cures; mentions surgery (Princess Vishpala).
'Satyameva Jayate' from Mundaka Upanishad (Atharva); Brahmanas: Rig-Aitareya/Kaushitaki, Sama-Panchavimsha, Yajur-Taittiriya, Atharva-Gopatha.

check.q: Who proposed the Aryan Invasion Theory?
In which Mandala of Rig Veda is the Purusha Sukta found, describing the origin of the Varna system?
Which Veda is associated with the story of Yajnavalkya vomiting the Krishna Yajur and learning Shukla Yajur from the Sun God?
